answer: SELECT ra.name FROM results res JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND res.rank > 0 ORDER BY res.rank ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE res.rank BETWEEN 1 AND 20 ORDER BY res.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY res.driverId ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(dob)) / 365.0 AS INT) AS age, forename || ' ' || surname AS name FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE res.raceId = 872 AND res.statusId = 1 ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ra.name, res.points FROM results res JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE res.driverId = 1 ORDER BY ra.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM pitStops p JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31' GROUP BY p.driverId ORDER BY AVG(p.milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS completion_rate FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId WHERE r.raceId BETWEEN 50 AND 100 AND s.status = 'Disqualified'
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
